title: TSQAgent: Rating Time Series Data Quality via Dedicated Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03629v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Assessing the quality of time series (TS) data is fundamental yet inherently challenging due to the multifaceted nature of quality dimensions. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for TS quality assessment via pairwise comparison and per-dimension evaluation. However, existing approaches rely on manually predefined quality dimensions and purely text-based reasoning, leaving it unknown whether LLMs can identify truly relevant quality dimensions or perform grounded and quantitative quality comparisons. To investigate this, we construct TSQBench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating LLMs on two progressive capabilities: (i) understanding and identifying relevant quality dimensions, and (ii) performing quality comparison under specific dimensions. Our analysis reveals that current LLMs consistently struggle with both dimension identification and evidence-grounded quality comparison. To address these

translated_title: TSQAgent：通过专用智能体推理评估时间序列数据质量
translated_abstract: 评估时间序列（TS）数据的质量是一项基础性工作，但由于质量维度的多面性，这本身极具挑战性。近来，大语言模型（LLM）已成为时间序列质量评估的一种有前景的范式，其方法包括成对比较和按维度评估。然而，现有方法依赖于人工预定义的质量维度和纯文本推理，尚不清楚大语言模型能否识别真正相关的质量维度，或进行有据可依的定量质量比较。为探究这一问题，我们构建了TSQBench，这是一个专门用于评估大语言模型两项递进能力的基准：(i) 理解并识别相关的质量维度，(ii) 在特定维度下进行质量比较。我们的分析表明，当前的大语言模型在维度识别和基于证据的质量比较两方面均持续存在困难。为解决这些问题……
tldr: 本文构建了TSQBench基准，揭示当前大语言模型在时间序列质量维度识别与有据可依的质量比较上的不足，并据此提出专用智能体推理框架TSQAgent，以实现更可靠的时间序列数据质量评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TSQBench, revealing that current LLMs struggle with quality dimension identification and evidence-grounded comparison for time series data, and proposes TSQAgent, a dedicated agentic reasoning framework for reliable time series data quality assessment.
